name: data-deletion
title_zh: 挨个敲掉数据掮客存你的那份档案
tagline_zh: 姓名、邮箱、电话、用户名，在 OSINT 工具和 B2B 数据库里被转卖了多少手？
tagline_en: Your name, email, phone, username—sold across OSINT tools and B2B databases. It walks you through.
desc_en: Run a structured personal-data erasure campaign against OSINT tools, breach-search engines, people-search sites, B2B contact databases and ad-tech brokers. Use when someone wants their email address, name, phone number or username removed from data brokers, wants to know who is holding their data, asks about GDPR / CCPA / PIPEDA erasure or "right to be forgotten" requests, or asks to opt out of pe
why_zh: 不是给你一份模板让你自己填——它按数据掮客的类别分批推进，跟踪每个请求的状态，知道哪些平台接受邮件。
why_en: Not just a template dump—it batches brokers by type, tracks each request's status, and knows which accept email, which need web.
limit_zh: 只处理美国、欧盟、加拿大的数据掮客与泄露搜索引擎；不含征信机构（Equifax 等）冻结、不含社交媒体账号注销。
limit_en: US/EU/CA data brokers & breach-search only. No credit bureaus (Equifax etc.), no social account deletion. It logs receipts but can't verify actual.
title_en: Knock your profile out of data brokers one by one
